```{r}
## Setting random seed for mediation analyses
set.seed(20231129)
```

```{r}
## Loading packages
library(pacman)
p_load(qualtRics, janitor, stargazer, pander, printy, emmeans, plotrix, psych,
       effectsize, mediation, tidyverse)
```

```{r}
## Setting options for viewing summary tables
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Reading in raw data
e4 <- read_survey("E4_Data.csv")
```

```{r}
## Cleaning
e4_clean <- e4 %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(finished == 1,
         is.na(age) == FALSE,
         is.na(political_leanings) == TRUE) %>%  
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         policy = if_else(type == "punishments", "punishment", "reward"),
         pun_rew_con = case_when(policy == "punishment" ~ -1, policy == "reward" ~ 1),
         frame = if_else(condition == "prevent", "prevent", "fix"),
         prev_fix_con = case_when(frame == "prevent" ~ -1, frame == "fix" ~ 1),
         pref = case_when(policy == "punishment" & frame == "prevent" ~ pp_dv,
                          policy == "punishment" & frame == "fix" ~ pf_dv,
                          policy == "reward" & frame == "prevent" ~ rp_dv,
                          policy == "reward" & frame == "fix" ~ rf_dv),
         fp_vividness_1 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fp1"))), na.rm = T),
         fp_vividness_2 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fp2"))), na.rm = T),
         fp_vividness_3 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fp3"))), na.rm = T),
         fp_vividness_4 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fp4"))), na.rm = T),
         fp_vividness_5 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fp5"))), na.rm = T),
         fp_vividness_6 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fp6"))), na.rm = T),
         fn_vividness_1 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fn1"))), na.rm = T),
         fn_vividness_2 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fn2"))), na.rm = T),
         fn_vividness_3 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fn3"))), na.rm = T),
         fn_vividness_4 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fn4"))), na.rm = T),
         fn_vividness_5 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fn5"))), na.rm = T),
         fn_vividness_6 = rowMeans(across(c(ends_with("_fn6"))), na.rm = T),
         fp_vividness = rowMeans(across(c(starts_with("fp_vividness_"))), na.rm = T),
         fn_vividness = rowMeans(across(c(starts_with("fn_vividness_"))), na.rm = T),
         rel_vividness = fp_vividness-fn_vividness) %>% 
  select(id, policy, pun_rew_con, frame, prev_fix_con, pref, 
         fp_vividness_1:rel_vividness, gender, age)
```

\clearpage

# Sample

```{r}
## Collecting descriptives
pct_male = round((sum(e4_clean$gender == 1)/nrow(e4_clean))*100, 2)
pct_female = round((sum(e4_clean$gender == 2)/nrow(e4_clean))*100, 2)
pct_nonbinary = round((sum(e4_clean$gender == 3)/nrow(e4_clean))*100, 2)
mean_age = round(mean(e4_clean$age), 2)
sd_age = round(sd(e4_clean$age), 2)
```


We aimed to recruit 600 U.S. MTurk participants via CloudResearch for this study.

Participants from the raw Qualtrics data were only included in this analysis if they completed the survey in its entirety and passed a preregistered attention check, leaving us with `r nrow(e4_clean)` participants (`r pct_female`% female, `r pct_male`% male, `r pct_nonbinary`% nonbinary; Mean~Age~ = `r mean_age`, SD~Age~ = `r sd_age`).

\clearpage

## DV

## Means

```{r}
## Collecting means
e4_clean %>% 
  rename(Policy = policy,
         Frame = frame) %>% 
  mutate(Policy = recode(Policy, punishment = "Punishments", reward = "Rewards"),
         Frame = recode(Frame, prevent = "Prevent", fix = "Fix")) %>%
  group_by(Policy, Frame) %>% 
  summarize("Mean Prop. Addressing FNs" = round(mean(pref), 2),
            "Std. Error" = round(std.error(pref), 2),
            "CI - Lower" = round((mean(pref) - (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "CI - Upper" = round((mean(pref) + (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "N" = n()) %>% 
  arrange(Policy, desc(Frame)) %>% 
  pander(caption = "Means by Policy, Frame (Note that 0 = FP and 1 = FN)",
         split.table = Inf)
```

\clearpage

## Regression Results

Below we conduct a logistic regression of policy (-1 = Punishments; 1 = Rewards), frame (-1 = Prevent; 1 = Fix), and their interaction upon preferences (0 = FP; 1 = FN). 

```{r}
## Regression
m1 <- glm(pref ~ prev_fix_con*pun_rew_con, data = e4_clean, family = binomial)
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
## Pretty-printing regression results
stargazer(m1, 
          title = "Regression Results - DV",
          header = FALSE,
          p.auto = TRUE,
          report = ('vc*sp'),
          star.cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
          type = "latex",
          font.size = "scriptsize")
```

```{r, results = FALSE}
## Collecting more details on the coefficient of interest
ixn_coef <- fmt_effect_md(m1, "prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con", "bespi", statistic = "z")
ixn_or <- round(exp(coef(m1)["prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con"]), 2)
ixn_or_lower <- round(exp(confint(m1)["prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con", 1]), 2)
ixn_or_upper <- round(exp(confint(m1)["prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con", 2]), 2)
```

We are primarily interested in the interaction, for which we observe the following values: `r ixn_coef`. Additionally, the odds ratio for this term (which we will use as a measure of effect size) is `r ixn_or` (95% CI = [`r ixn_or_lower`, `r ixn_or_upper`]).

\clearpage

## Simple Effects

```{r}
## Collecting simple effects and effect sizes
simple_effects <- 
  summary(emtrends(m1, pairwise ~ pun_rew_con, var = "prev_fix_con")$emtrends, infer = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(Policy = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ "Pun.", pun_rew_con == 1 ~ "Rew."),
         prev_fix_con.trend = round(prev_fix_con.trend, 2),
         SE = round(SE, 2),
         asymp.LCL = round(asymp.LCL, 2),
         asymp.UCL = round(asymp.UCL, 2),
         z.ratio = round(z.ratio, 2),
         "Odds Ratio" = round(exp(prev_fix_con.trend), 2),
         "OR - Lower" = round(exp(asymp.LCL), 2),
         "OR - Upper" = round(exp(asymp.UCL), 2),) %>% 
  select(Policy, prev_fix_con.trend, SE, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL, z.ratio, p.value,
         "Odds Ratio", "OR - Lower", "OR - Upper") %>% 
  rename("*b*" = prev_fix_con.trend, 
         "95% CI, Lower" = asymp.LCL,
         "95% CI, Upper" = asymp.UCL,
         "*z*" = z.ratio,
         "*p*" = p.value)

simple_effects %>% 
  pander(caption = "Simple Effects of Frame at Each Level of Type", 
         split.table = Inf)
```

\clearpage

# Mediator (Relative Vividness)

## Scale Reliability Analysis

First we conduct a scale reliability analysis to confirm the appropriateness of using our six vividness measures to compute mean vividness scores for false positives and false negatives, and subsequently, a relative vividness score estimated as the vividness of false positives minus the vividness of false negatives.

```{r, results = TRUE}
psych::alpha(select(e4_clean, fp_vividness_1, fp_vividness_2, fp_vividness_3,
                    fp_vividness_4, fp_vividness_5, fp_vividness_6,
                    fn_vividness_1, fn_vividness_2, fn_vividness_3,
                    fn_vividness_4, fn_vividness_5, fn_vividness_6))
```

\clearpage

## Means

```{r}
## Collecting means
e4_clean %>% 
  rename(Policy = policy,
         Frame = frame) %>% 
  mutate(Policy = recode(Policy, punishment = "Punishments", reward = "Rewards"),
         Frame = recode(Frame, prevent = "Prevent", fix = "Fix")) %>%
  group_by(Policy, Frame) %>% 
  summarize("Mean Prop. Addressing FNs" = round(mean(rel_vividness), 2),
            "Std. Error" = round(std.error(rel_vividness), 2),
            "CI - Lower" = round((mean(rel_vividness) - (1.96*std.error(rel_vividness))), 2),
            "CI - Upper" = round((mean(rel_vividness) + (1.96*std.error(rel_vividness))), 2),
            "N" = n()) %>% 
  arrange(Policy, desc(Frame)) %>% 
  pander(caption = "Means by Policy, Frame (Note that 0 = FP and 1 = FN)",
         split.table = Inf)
```

\clearpage

## Regression Results

Below we conduct an OLS regression of policy (-1 = Punishments; 1 = Rewards), frame (-1 = Prevent; 1 = Fix), and their interaction upon relative vividness (0 = FP; 1 = FN). 

```{r}
## Regression
m2 <- lm(rel_vividness ~ prev_fix_con*pun_rew_con, data = e4_clean)
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
## Pretty-printing regression results
stargazer(m2, 
          title = "Regression Results - Mediator (Relative Vividness)",
          header = FALSE,
          p.auto = TRUE,
          report = ('vc*sp'),
          star.cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
          type = "latex",
          font.size = "scriptsize")
```

```{r, results = FALSE}
## Collecting more details on the coefficient of interest
ixn_coef_med <- fmt_effect_md(m2, "prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con", "beSpi")
ixn_f2_med <- round(cohens_f_squared(m2, alternative = "two.sided")[3, 2], 2)
ixn_f2_lower_med <- round(cohens_f_squared(m2, alternative = "two.sided")[3, 4], 3)
ixn_f2_upper_med <- round(cohens_f_squared(m2, alternative = "two.sided")[3, 5], 2)
```

We are primarily interested in the interaction, for which we observe the following values: `r ixn_coef_med`. Additionally, Cohen's $f^2$ for this term (which we will use as a measure of effect size) is `r ixn_f2_med` (95% CI = [`r ixn_f2_lower_med`, `r ixn_f2_upper_med`]).

\clearpage

## Simple Effects

```{r}
## Collecting simple effects and effect sizes
simple_effects <- 
  summary(emtrends(m2, pairwise ~ pun_rew_con, var = "prev_fix_con")$emtrends, infer = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(Policy = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ "Pun.", pun_rew_con == 1 ~ "Rew."),
         prev_fix_con.trend = round(prev_fix_con.trend, 2),
         SE = round(SE, 2),
         lower.CL = round(lower.CL, 2),
         upper.CL = round(upper.CL, 2),
         t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 2),
         "*d*" = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ 
                             abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == -1)$rel_vividness,
                                                filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == 1)$rel_vividness)[,1], 2)),
                           pun_rew_con == 1 ~
                             abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == -1)$rel_vividness,
                                                filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == 1)$rel_vividness)[,1], 2))),
         "*d* - Upper" = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ 
                                     abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == -1)$rel_vividness,
                                                        filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == 1)$rel_vividness)[,3], 2)),
                                   pun_rew_con == 1 ~
                                     abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == -1)$rel_vividness,
                                                        filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == 1)$rel_vividness)[,4], 2))),
         "*d* - Lower" = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ 
                                     abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == -1)$rel_vividness,
                                                        filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == 1)$rel_vividness)[,4], 2)),
                                   pun_rew_con == 1 ~
                                     abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == -1)$rel_vividness,
                                                        filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == 1)$rel_vividness)[,3], 2)))) %>% 
  select(Policy, prev_fix_con.trend, SE, lower.CL, upper.CL, t.ratio, p.value,
         "*d*", "*d* - Lower", "*d* - Upper") %>% 
  rename("*b*" = prev_fix_con.trend, 
         "95% CI, Lower" = lower.CL,
         "95% CI, Upper" = upper.CL,
         "*t*" = t.ratio,
         "*p*" = p.value)

simple_effects %>% 
  pander(caption = "Simple Effects of Frame at Each Level of Type", 
         split.table = Inf)
```

\clearpage

# Mediation

## Punishments

```{r}
## Constructing models and running mediation for Punishments
outmed_pun <- lm(rel_vividness ~ prev_fix_con, 
                 data = filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == - 1))

outmain_pun <- glm(pref ~ prev_fix_con + rel_vividness, 
                   data = filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == - 1), 
                   family = binomial(link = "probit"))

mediation_pun <- mediate(outmed_pun, outmain_pun, boot = TRUE, sims = 10000,
                         treat = "prev_fix_con", mediator = "rel_vividness")
```

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
## Mediation Results - Punishments
summary(mediation_pun)

## 95% CI for ACME (Average)
mediation_pun$d.avg.ci

## 95% CI for Avg. Prop. Mediated
mediation_pun$n.avg.ci
```

\clearpage

## Rewards

```{r}
## Constructing models and running mediation for Rewards
outmed_rew <- lm(rel_vividness ~ prev_fix_con, 
                 data = filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == 1))

outmain_rew <- glm(pref ~ prev_fix_con + rel_vividness, 
                  data = filter(e4_clean, pun_rew_con == 1),
                  family = binomial(link = "probit"))

mediation_rew <- mediate(outmed_rew, outmain_rew, sims = 10000, boot = FALSE, 
                         treat = "prev_fix_con", mediator = "rel_vividness")
```

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
## Mediation Results - Rewards
summary(mediation_rew)

## 95% CI for ACME (Average)
mediation_rew$d.avg.ci

## 95% CI for Avg. Prop. Mediated
mediation_rew$n.avg.ci
```

\clearpage

## Mediation Sensitivity Analyses

## Punishments

```{r}
## Running sensitivity analysis for Punishments
sens_pun <- medsens(mediation_pun, rho.by = 0.01, sims = 10000)
```


```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
## Sensitivity Analysis Results - Punishments 
summary(sens_pun)
```

\clearpage

## Rewards

```{r}
## Running sensitivity analysis for Rewards
sens_rew <- medsens(mediation_rew, rho.by = 0.01, sims = 10000)
```

